data.one_liner: Render VIDEO tags using Chewie inside HtmlWidget
data.what_it_does: It extends HtmlWidget to replace <video> tags with a Chewie video player. It supports flutter_widget_from_html_core and video_player dependencies. It works on Android, iOS, web, macOS.
use_when: You need to display video content from HTML in a Flutter app
You already use flutter_widget_from_html_core and want a ready‑made video player
avoid_when: You prefer a different video player like just_audio or audioplayers
You need advanced custom controls not provided by Chewie
strengths: Keeps video logic separate from HTML parsing
weaknesses: Depends on Chewie, so inherits its limitations
No custom control overrides beyond Chewie defaults
data.setup_notes: Add fwfh_chewie and flutter_widget_from_html_core to pubspec, then mix in ChewieFactory into your WidgetFactory
